You may be eligible to apply for a Change of Income – Special Circumstance Review.

Death, separation, divorce, unemployment, loss of employment, unusual medical/dental care expenses, or loss of non-taxable income or benefits are all examples of unusual circumstances that may affect your financial aid eligibility.

Dependency Status - Unusual Circumstance Unusual Circumstances refer to the conditions that justify an aid administrator making an adjustment to a student’s dependency status based on a unique situation (e.g., human trafficking, refugee or asylee status, parental abuse or abandonment, incarceration), more commonly referred to as a dependency override.
The student must then contact the Financial Aid Office to complete the appropriate steps for requesting a review of their Request for Review of Dependency Status – Unusual Circumstances.
